titleNative: 향단뎐
synonyms: Hyangdan Chronicles
synopsis: Job seeker Yu Hyang-Gi, struggling day by day, one day finds herself possessed by Hyang-Dan, the character from the traditional Korean folktale Chunhyangjeon. A supporting character, not even the heroine? How wonderful! Our beautiful young lady Chunhyang, and even a madam who cares for her like her own daughter. Hyang-Dan, who only felt the warmth of family after being possessed by the novel, was enjoying a peaceful life. Until "him" showed up! The world's ultimate villain, Byun Hak-Do, is destined to harass Chunhyang and be executed by the male protagonist, Lee Mong-Ryong. How dare he look down on our Chunhyang! "I don't know who you are, but you're a brat." "I've been waiting." "That's why I'm offering you this. An honor no one else can attain." But why do you keep entangling yourself with me? Why does that man care more about me than Chunhyang? A romantic fantasy about Hyang-Dan and Byeon Hak-Do, a twist on classic novels, Hyangdan's Tale. (Source: Kakaopage, translated)

title: This Alluring Dark Elf Has the Heart of a Middle-Aged Man!

synopsis: With no friends, family, or romance to speak of, Haruka has lived his life just going through the motions—until the day he awakens in the body of a beautiful, and womanly, dark elf! Suddenly, a world beyond his wildest imagination awaits, and uncontainable excitement races through him. There's just one problem: He gave up on putting himself out there a long time ago and has no idea how to strike up a conversation with other people. Teenagers and (other) women are certainly no exception. But with a bottomless well of mana and a ridiculously tough body to boot, Haruka won't let any overthinking get in the way this time. Little by little, the dark elf works past his (her) fears and self-doubt, forging deep bonds with precious new friends and growing together with them. So begins a heartwarming story of an old man determined to make the most of this new fantastical lease on life! (Source: J-Novel Club)

Despite being nobles, the Granger family is destitute! Patience is desperate to figure out how to help her family, including her adorable younger brothers, but her magic proficiency lies in household magic—a type relating to domestic chores. Not only does she have her family to worry about but Patience is also ten years old. She'll be enrolling in the Royal Academy, where she'll have to navigate relationships with other nobles while trying to grow her skills. Using her knowledge from her past life and the memories she has from the original Patience, this young noble is determined to use her talents to protect her angelic little brothers! synopsis: This story takes place in a particular town with two infamous schools in constant dispute: Chidori High, a boys' school predominantly attended by low-class students with damning grades, and its neighbor Kikyo Girls' High, with most of its female students coming from wealthy and prestigious families. One day, high school second-year Rintaro Tsumugi, a fierce-looking but gentle-minded student at Chidori, is helping at his family's patisserie when he encounters a female customer by the name of Kaoruko Waguri. Rintaro enjoys his time with Kaoruko, as she doesn't judge him for his appearance, but this blissful peace is quickly disturbed when Rintaro makes the discovery that Kaoruko is actually a student at Kikyo. This revelation marks the beginning of the two's strenuous tale, as they fight against the limitations placed upon them by their schools and surroundings in an attempt to find their own path! (Source: K Manga)

synopsis: The first "Love Live!" series comic adaptation by Shueisha! Hasunosora Girls' High School, located in a remote area of Kanazawa City, Ishikawa Prefecture, beside a lake with lotus flowers in bloom. At this high school, which was founded over 100 years ago, the traditions handed down from long ago still live. This is where an energetic girl called Kaho Hinoshita enrolls with the goal of "blossoming". After being frustrated at first for not getting what she is looking for, she will discover something that will change her vision of Hasunosora: school idols.
